page_note: Page is dominated by an anthropological-cosmological teaching contrasting the New Man (with his counsel, patience, wisdom, reflection, love, faith, perfection — ruled by the Mind of Light) with the Old Man (bound in body with desire, greed, foolishness — mingled with the spirit of darkness/Sin). This is substrate teaching: both sides of the mapping stay within the cosmic-anthropological system (New Man / Old Man / Sin / Mind of Light / twelve members / five members of the body). Heavy manuscript damage (83%) but the teaching arc is clear. The page's editorial fatigue score is real and visible: at segment 32 a clear seam pivots into ecclesial application — when Sin's foolishness manifests, "in the church, the teachers and presbyters gather as helpers and straighten his wisdom." Segments 32-35 apply the cosmic teaching to Manichaean church discipline. The seam flag at i=32 correctly identifies this transition.
